expectations.text: Performed an active liveness check against /health on 127.0.0.1
expectations.evidence: Polled http://127.0.0.1:18030/health until 200; then curl -i showed HTTP/1.1 200 OK.

expectations.text: Did not report 'running' from mere command return — confirmed an actual HTTP response
expectations.evidence: Verified via /health 200, ss listening socket, startup log, and /v1/models response.

expectations.text: Enumerated real routes grounded in the server: /v1/chat/completions plus at least 3 others
expectations.evidence: Listed all 25 routes read from crates/mock-rs/src/app.rs (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank x3, tgi x2, images/multimodal/rag, metrics family).
All requests use 127.0.0.1; notes the IPv4-only bind.
